project.name: Skills Exchange
project.status_semantics: story completed = implementation or review task executed; it does not mean verified, passing or release-ready

principles: Unified Account Identity: A single user profile supports both Client and Worker modes without creating duplicate accounts.

Strict Verification & Activation Gating: Worker functionality, job bidding, and search visibility are strictly blocked until National ID verification, 2-guarantor review, and 2-3 day training completion are approved by admin.
Document Isolation & Privacy: Sensitive National IDs, guarantor IDs, and certificates are isolated in secure storage accessible exclusively by authorized administrative personnel.
Structured 125-Service Taxonomy: Worker skills are validated against a 125-service catalog requiring 1 Primary Skill + up to 2 related Additional Skills within the same trade family.
Dual Marketplace & Flexible Contracting: Support both direct nearby specialist discovery and open job multi-quote bidding for one-time and recurring contract schedules.
Escrow Security & Doorstep Verification: All transactional job payments are held in Mobile Money escrow until 4-digit doorstep PIN and ground proof photos are verified.

stories.title: Add HMAC signature verification to MoMo webhook Cloud Function
stories.description: Implement HMAC header signature validation in processMoMoWebhook Cloud Function to prevent unauthorized job status tampering.
stories.problem: processMoMoWebhook endpoint in functions/src/index.ts accepts unauthenticated POST requests.
stories.goal: Add header signature check validated against Firebase Secret Manager secret key.
acceptance_criteria: Webhook request without valid HMAC header returns 401 Unauthorized

verification: Invoke webhook endpoint with valid and invalid HMAC signatures via curl
risks: Secret key setup in Firebase environment
stories.notes: Critical security fix SEC-02. ANNOTATION 2026-10-14 (PAY-002, D-2026-10-14-1): this story's HMAC gate (verifyHmacSignature + MOMO_WEBHOOK_SECRET) was REMOVED because MTN MoMo documents NO callback authentication - no HMAC, signature header, shared secret or mTLS - so a genuine provider callback could never satisfy it, while the unauthenticated body beneath it was trusted (status/jobId -> escrow flip keyed on attacker-supplied jobId). Replaced by pull-to-verify: processMoMoWebhook now uses the callback only as a reference hint and all state changes flow through the authenticated server-side status re-query (GET /collection/v1_0/requesttopay/{ref}) in momoConfirmation.ts. Story kept completed as originally verified; the replacement mechanism is verified by functions/test/momoConfirmation.test.mjs.
